claims.disproof_condition: 條件：K&S 後續季報的打線機營收連兩季年減，或它把這一波需求寫成一次性的中國擴產或國產替代並說明不會延續。核查頻率：每季（10-Q）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 加註、重讀打線設備層（tech:wire_bonding），K&S 敘事重寫（缺 X 轉不要）。
claims.statement: K&S's 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-07-04: ball bonding equipment revenue was $226.1 million (68.4% of revenue, up 197.5% year on year), which it attributes to higher sales volume in general semiconductor (about $126.6 million), memory (about $19.4 million) and automotive and industrial (about $4.1 million) end markets, driven by customer technology transitions and improved demand conditions; three Chinese assembly houses each exceeded 10% of nine-month revenue. Supplier self-report; it does not attribute the demand to AI or name what its customers build with the bonders.
